definitions.gloss: the hard outer shell of an egg
definitions.explanation: The hard, brittle outer covering of a bird's egg, mostly made of calcium carbonate. A somewhat technical or written term.

examples.japanese: {卵殻|らんかく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{炭酸|たんさん}→炭酸：13376_tansan⟧⟦カルシウム→カルシウム：10963_karushiumu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Eggshells are made of calcium carbonate.

examples.japanese: {卵殻|らんかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{細|こま}かく→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦{砕|くだ}いた→砕く：03920_kudaku⟧。
examples.english: I crushed the eggshell into small pieces.

examples.japanese: {卵殻|らんかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{肥料|ひりょう}→肥料：06102_hiryou⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧まく⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Some people scatter eggshells on fields as fertilizer.

notes:
A technical or written term for an eggshell. In everyday conversation, ⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{殻|から}→殻：02148_kara⟧ is used instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {卵殻|らんかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{砕|くだ}く→砕く：03920_kudaku⟧: to crush an eggshell
- {卵殻|らんかく}{膜|まく}: eggshell membrane

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{殻|から}→殻：02148_kara⟧: shell — the general word for a shell of an egg, nut, or shellfish
- ⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{殻|から}→殻：02148_kara⟧: eggshell — the everyday phrasing of the same thing
